meta.name: The Wolves of Real Estate: The Alexander Brothers
meta.description: Investigates how three successful brothers ascended in the elite world of luxury real estate and private security in Miami and New York, all while harboring an extremely dark secret.

videos.title: The Brothers
videos.overview: The Alexander brothers ascend in real estate, but harbor secrets of alleged mistreatment of women.

videos.title: Back to Miami
videos.overview: Allegations of how the brothers mistreated women in high school surface and raise questions.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: The net closes in on the Alexander brothers, leading to their arrest and a sex-trafficking trial.
